measurements.name: specimen_melanophore_wavelength
measurements.reference_source: slot scale 0.0001011 m (tier 5_primordium_100um detail); onset formula 2π/k_c
measurements.method: radial FFT peak of the nonlinear periodic field; RMSE against the analytical sweep

measurements.name: wavelength_sweep_pearson_r
measurements.reference_source: MorphoEval gate Pearson r > 0.98 (threshold, not a fitted self-copy)
measurements.method: Pearson r of measured vs analytical λ_c across six diffusivity-scaled domains; RMSE and KS reported alongside

measurements.name: wavelength_sweep_rmse
measurements.method: RMSE between analytical onset wavelengths and nonlinear FFT peaks

measurements.name: wavelength_sweep_ks
measurements.reference_source: KS statistic of identical samples would be 0
measurements.method: two-sample KS between analytical and measured wavelength lists; p reported in metrics.json

measurements.name: ablation_amplitude_ratio
measurements.reference_source: null control D_v = D_u (no Turing instability) would match the patterned amplitude
measurements.method: std(patterned)/std(ablation control) at equal D_u; ablation h = D(f_u+g_v) < 0

measurements.name: neumann_patch_wavelength
measurements.reference_source: same 101.1 µm onset target, no-flux dermal patch instead of the periodic ring
measurements.method: reflect-padded Laplacian control vs periodic hero run

measurements.name: specimen_structure_tensor_coherency
measurements.reference_source: coherency of the rendered melanophore field (not a copy of the photograph)
measurements.method: CV segmentation of the public-domain specimen (border contrast, Sobel structure tensor) versus the simulation

measurements.name: specimen_foreground_fraction
measurements.reference_source: neutral fill; the photograph is not a half-empty mask
measurements.method: foreground fraction from the fitness-test specimen segmentation

measurements.name: dispersion_curve_pearson_r
measurements.method: Pearson r of analytical dispersion against early Fourier growth of a 10^-4 perturbation

measurements.name: cellular_predecessor_mode_count
measurements.reference_source: eight modes in the 808.8 µm primordium patch (L/λ_c)
measurements.method: integer mode count on a 40 µm cellular predecessor domain versus this 101.1 µm wavelength
